summary: Ranked bar list with dithered bars behind the labels that grow in one after another; hover or focus runs a sheen along a bar.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Comma-separated `label:value` rows, split at the last colon; an entry without a colon has the value 0. Rows are sorted by value, highest first. Observed: a new value rebuilds the rows.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Header text on the left; also labels the list. Observed.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Header text on the right, above the values. Observed.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Rows parsed from `data`, sorted by value, highest first.

accessibility: The rows form a `role="list"` labelled by the header; each row is a `listitem` with `tabindex="0"` and an `aria-label` of the form `label: value`.
Focusing a row runs the same sheen as hover.
motion: With reduced motion the bars appear at full width without growing and no sheen runs; the hover highlight still fades.
notes: Bar lengths are relative to the largest value; negative values get no bar.
Changing `data` rebuilds the rows and the bars grow in again; focus stays on the same row position.

data.note: Pass your `label:value` rows as `data`; the read-only `items` property returns them parsed. Without it the list shows demo file names with invented edit counts.
